definitions.explanation: Someone who secretly passes information to the opposing side while remaining part of their own group. Strongly negative — the word implies betrayal, not whistleblowing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{内通者|ないつうしゃ}がいた。
examples.english: There was a mole inside the organization.

examples.japanese: {内通者|ないつうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{探|さが}し{出|だ}す⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took time to track down the inside collaborator.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漏|も}れていた→漏れる：02435_moreru⟧こと⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{内通者|ないつうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{疑|うたが}われた→疑う：01889_utagau⟧。
examples.english: Because the plan had leaked in advance, the presence of a mole was suspected.

notes:
Formed from {内通|ないつう} (secret communication with the enemy) plus 〜⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person who). Most at home in war stories, crime fiction, and corporate-espionage reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内通者|ないつうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{疑|うたが}う→疑う：01889_utagau⟧: to suspect someone of being a mole
- {内通者|ないつうしゃ}{狩|が}り: a hunt for the informant
- ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内通者|ないつうしゃ}: the enemy's inside man

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{密告者|みっこくしゃ}→密告者：21188_mikkokusha⟧: informer — reports others to the authorities; not necessarily an insider serving a rival
- ⟦{裏切|うらぎ}り{者|もの}→裏切り者：25800_uragirimono⟧: traitor — the everyday word, broader and not limited to passing information
- ⟦スパイ→スパイ：18236_supai⟧: spy — planted from outside, whereas an {内通者|ないつうしゃ} is a genuine member who turns
